tasks.label: CROWN: sync main
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; git switch main; git pull --ff-only origin main; git status --short

tasks.label: CROWN: PR same-SHA poll prompt
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $n = Read-Host 'PR number'; $pr = gh pr view $n --json number,state,isDraft,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,url | ConvertFrom-Json; $pending=@($pr.statusCheckRollup | ? { $_.status -ne 'COMPLETED' }).Count; $failed=@($pr.statusCheckRollup | ? { $_.status -eq 'COMPLETED' -and $_.conclusion -in @('FAILURE','TIMED_OUT','ACTION_REQUIRED','STALE','STARTUP_FAILURE') }).Count; $cancelled=@($pr.statusCheckRollup | ? { $_.status -eq 'COMPLETED' -and $_.conclusion -eq 'CANCELLED' }).Count; 'PR='+$pr.number; 'STATE='+$pr.state; 'DRAFT='+$pr.isDraft; 'MERGEABLE='+$pr.mergeable; 'HEAD='+$pr.headRefOid; 'PENDING='+$pending; 'FAILED='+$failed; 'CANCELLED='+$cancelled; 'URL='+$pr.url; if ($pr.state -ne 'OPEN') { throw 'PR is not open.' }; if ($pr.isDraft) { throw 'PR is draft.' }; if ($pr.mergeable -ne 'MERGEABLE') { throw 'PR is not MERGEABLE.' }; if ($pending -ne 0 -or $failed -ne 0 -or $cancelled -ne 0) { throw "Do not merge: pending=$pending failed=$failed cancelled=$cancelled" }

tasks.label: CROWN: guarded work session start prompt
CROWN: guarded work session close prompt
